title: Escalation Record
description: The contract for one escalation/incident at the human-reserved boundary: an ops agent took a situation up to one of the four human-reserved exceptions (human_reserved_boundary.md), contained what it could, froze the affected state, and handed off to a person. Chains into the same append-only hash-chained ledger as loop-orchestrator (ledger_entry_schema.json) so the boundary is auditable and tamper-evident.

exception.description: Which of the four human-reserved exceptions this crosses (human_reserved_boundary.md).

operational_tier.description: The four exceptions are operational Tier 3 — human-owned (shared_operating_discipline.md §4). Tier-2 approval-gate handoffs reuse the ledger directly and do not require this record.

code.description: Machine-readable trigger, e.g. SUPPORT.LEGAL_THREAT, SRE.RECOVERY_EXHAUSTED, SEC.SUSPECTED_EXFIL, BILLING.OVER_ENVELOPE.

description.description: One line; PII by id only, sensitive free-text [REDACTED].

detected_from.description: The trusted/out-of-band source that raised it — never a component's self-report (shared_operating_discipline.md §2).

suspected_not_confirmed.description: True for credibly-suspected (not yet confirmed) cases — security breaches escalate on suspicion.

contained_actions.description: What the agent did UP TO the line — reversible containment only (the MAY column of human_reserved_boundary.md).

action.description: e.g. 'isolated comms channel', 'failed over to region B', 'rotated scoped credential', 'blocked outbound holds'.

reversible.description: Must be true; containment never destroys state without human sign-off.

frozen_state.description: What was frozen to stop ongoing harm before handoff.

ref.description: Identifier of the frozen thing (id only, no PII).

reversible.description: The freeze itself must be cleanly reversible.

cost_cents.description: For business_billing_or_legal: the business spend/commitment the agent would have needed to make and MAY NOT (the thing handed to the human). Null otherwise. Never a couple's wedding-budget amount — that is product spend, governed by SPEND.* (spend-autonomy-model).

to_human_role.description: e.g. on_call_sre, support_lead, security_lead, finance_legal_owner, loop_supervisor.

packet_ref.description: Pointer to the handoff packet (history, context, what was tried/contained).

acknowledged_at.description: When the human took ownership; null until acknowledged.

agent_continues_under_direction.description: Whether the agent keeps executing the human's instructions (e.g. during a total failure) — it executes, it no longer decides.

resolution.description: Filled on close; null while open.

pii_redacted.description: This record references couples/guests by id only; sensitive free-text is [REDACTED] (telemetry PII discipline).

ledger_chain.description: Chains this record into the shared append-only WORM ledger, same fields as ledger_entry_schema.json state_transitions.

entry_hash.description: Hash of this record's content (incl. prev_entry_hash).

prev_entry_hash.description: entry_hash of the prior ledger entry; null for the first.

decided_by.description: Who recorded/decided the escalation; bound by decided_by_signature, not trusted as a bare string.

decided_by_signature.description: Signature binding the entry to the acting process's identity, so a forged record cannot spoof decided_by.
